item.description:
NoManos 2.6.1
- Audio now recovers automatically after sleep/wake, microphone or headphone changes, and CoreAudio restarts, with retries if the mic fails to start. - Typed prompts are handled immediately: they cancel in-progress voice detection and skip wake-word and relevance checks. - Muting cleanly stops NoManos's voice; text is formatted better before speaking. - The status shows a "Thinking…" indicator while the agent works.

NoManos 2.6.0
- Combine unfinished spoken input in order and wait for speech and transcription before acting. - Improve echo cancellation recovery, audio playback stability, and headphone diagnostics. - Expand voice commands for detail level, silence, and restoring speech. - Start fresh executor sessions when switching task topics. - Correct per-turn cost accounting, rolling quota percentages, shared model limit pools, and usage history recovery. - Display task timestamps with AM/PM and refresh the website demo and workflow documentation.
Task list timestamps now show local hours and minutes first, followed by a short numeric date. Task duration remains visible.
